faq.q: What drawing tools and presets are included?
faq.a: Pen, eraser, text, and five shapes: rectangle, ellipse, line, arrow (with drawn arrowhead), and triangle, each with color, stroke width (1–30), and an optional fill. Five presets set width, color, and font at once: Sketch, Annotate (red), Teach (thick blue), Highlighter (wide amber), and Fine (thin). The canvas is a fixed 1200x700 internal resolution scaled to fit your screen.

faq.q: Can I undo mistakes, and is my work saved?
faq.a: Yes. It keeps up to 30 image-snapshot undo states, with Undo/Redo buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y shortcuts. After every action the board auto-saves to local storage under wb_data as a PNG data URL, so reopening the page restores your last drawing. Clear wipes the board after a confirmation.

faq.q: How do I export or share the board?
faq.a: Three options: Download PNG, Download PDF (the PNG is embedded at full size into a one-page PDF using pdf-lib, fetched once on first visit then cached), and Copy board, which puts the canvas on your clipboard as a PNG via ClipboardItem so you can paste it into a chat or document. Everything is generated on your device.

faq.q: Does it work with touch and stylus?
faq.a: Yes. Drawing uses pointer events, so mouse, touch, and stylus all work, and the canvas sets touch-action to none to prevent scrolling while you draw. The text tool lets you click to place typed text at an adjustable font size (12–72). The page notes handwriting is easier with a stylus or by typing labels and drawing only the structure.
